attribute_definition_groups.name: Image With Text
attribute_definition_groups.description: An image with an optional text overlay, caption, and link.

attribute_definitions.name: Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: Accessibility alt text for the image.

attribute_definitions.description: Text overlay displayed centered on the image. Darkens the image when set.

attribute_definitions.description: Text displayed below the image as a caption.

attribute_definitions.name: Link URL
attribute_definitions.description: Optional URL that wraps the image in a link. Supports absolute and relative URLs.
